_comment: Rendered as-is, in order, in the homepage sidebar's Financial Calculators card. Add a new object here to add a new calculator to the sidebar automatically — no code changes needed. `url` is relative to index.html (the sidebar only renders on the homepage). `available: false` shows a 'Soon' badge but keeps the link clickable (it still routes to the calculators section). `icon` must be one of the keys in ICONS in scripts/lib/sidebar.js.
